title: Backyard Bird Hop
hook: One yard opens a window to birds around the world.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
visualStyle: sunny 3D backyard-bird storybook, fences shrubs feeders and sky kept simple, crisp isolated birds

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child comparing backyard observations with world bird cards
creativeFingerprint.grooveMeter: light 4/4 porch pulse with world-card pauses
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: hand-written habitat placement; non-backyard birds explicitly world comparisons
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: here/there cue -> recall beat -> target -> point/card gesture
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Round 1 paints clues; chorus opens wide; Round 2 strips back for recall. Signature: a whistle hop and hand-clap stop after the target, with no bird sound covering diction.
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: a whistle hop and hand-clap stop after the target, with no bird sound covering diction
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Repair the misleading Backyard Birds theme by turning it into a backyard observation board plus world-comparison cards: local-looking feeder birds sit beside clearly labeled birds from wetlands, tropics, open ocean or Southern Hemisphere habitats.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child starts at a yard feeder and compares each unfamiliar card to the backyard baseline, never claiming kiwi, ostrich, avocet or umbrellabird live in the yard.
